create_TensorboardWriter: create a TensorboardWriter instance from a config to log training metrics to Tensorboard
add_scalars: add multiple scalar values to Tensorboard logs with a data dictionary and global step
plot_eval: plot confusion matrices and histograms for model predictions versus true labels during evaluation
add_confusion_matrix: calculate and plot a confusion matrix to a Tensorboard SummaryWriter with optional class subsets
add_heatmap: add a viridis colormap heatmap to a 2D tensor and return a 3D tensor for visualization
